name: rest-server
title: Restic REST Server
description: The REST server is a place for restic backups from your other machines: each machine sends its backups here over HTTP, faster than over SFTP, and with --append-only a compromised machine cannot delete its old backups. After deploying, make a user with: docker exec -it Rest-Server create_user <name> (it is picked up within a minute) — then on the machine: restic -r rest:http://<name>:<password>@<this host>:8498/<name>/ init. Put it behind HTTPS before using it across the internet.
auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)

variables.name: PORT_REST_SERVER
variables.label: Port
variables.description: Host port restic clients connect to

variables.name: REST_SERVER_OPTIONS
variables.label: Options
variables.description: rest-server flags: --private-repos keeps each user in a folder of their own; add --append-only to forbid deleting
